chat.t: The moonlight shines upon the quiet lake
A butterfly lands upon the boundary
Is that which reflects on the water a butterfly, the moon, or perhaps myself?

o: What's this all of a sudden?

chat.t: My butterflies are watching you.
Yes.

o: I thought they flew over here because of my magnificent aura.

chat.t: Those that gather when they see light are moths.

o: But what's going on? Why are you watching me?

chat.t: My name is Kouchou.
Priestess of the Red Butterfly
I came to check on you, the one who caused ripples in the boundary.
You are just as I heard.

o: The rumors about me are exaggerated.

chat.t: But...
That kind of thing...
Sigh.
I can receive other people's emotions through my butterflies.
It is not a peephole.
You seem like a more dangerous person than I thought.
I should keep a butterfly on you.
They are spiritual creatures, so it will not work.
I will show some leniency on that.
I just need to avoid you from 10 to 11, right?

lines.t: The Panoticon incident is famous even in Quartet.
I'm impressed that my name has already spread that far.
The Conqueror of Panoticon, the Best Fixer, the leader of M.A.D...
There's a rumor that you're a <bouten>lecher</bouten> who tamed the Head Maid of the Panoticon.
Just what kind of person do people think I am!?
Rumors are always exaggerated and distorted.
That's way too extreme to just be a distortion!
Is that so? From what I heard, you occupied the Panoticon and made the Head Maid submit...
Wait, it's a misunderstanding. I'm innocent.
Yes! The situation was out of my hands... There was an unavoidable reason I had to...
Because her butt was right there?
Wait, wait! You said you came to check on me!? Let me explain! No, I have to explain!
I like sexy things, but I'm not a lecher.
They say there are people in this world who make the most unconvincing arguments, and it seems you are one of them.
Ah, this is driving me crazy, I'm telling you I'm not!
I suppose I have no choice. I will give you a chance.
Huh? The butterflies are... clinging to me?
The power of the red butterfly I possess connects people's hearts and emotions.
With this power, I will be able to know even the things you wish to hide.
For instance... what you did last night...
Last night... what on earth did you...
Hmm? What did you see that makes you say that?
Don't talk to me, don't come near me, don't breathe.
You have to let me breathe!
Anyway, I have learned plenty about you.
It seems your existence will be a grave threat to Quartet.
I will not even give you the right to remain silent.
Of course, as you said, your dangerous nature has not been fully proven yet.
So, to see if you are truly a dangerous existence...

chat.t: Ripples rise upon the water's surface
Is it because of the butterfly that took flight?
The sunken moon remains silent
No, it's not
Finding the culprit?
I want to verify the correlation between you and the boundary.

o: What are you going to make me do?

chat.t: Erotic.
I am going to observe you normally.
For now, meet me at the park.
The Fairwinds Association decided to take them in.
They needed someone to guard the warehouse.
There, they will not have to worry about losing their mother again.

o: If they lose her again, we can just find her for them.

chat.t: Thank you.
Never mind.

lines.t:
I arrived at our meeting spot, but for some reason,
Kouchou just sat on the bench and didn't move, even after seeing me.
What's up? Why are you sitting so still?
Are you exercising your right to remain silent? You have the right to an attorney...
When I casually looked down, I saw a little kitten sleeping on Kouchou's lap.
No. I was waiting in the park, and it just approached me.
I waited... but it seems they have been separated.
I am sorry. It seems our plans today...
Then let's look for her together.
You said it lost its mother, right? Then we can just look for her together.
But I cannot let you waste your time on something like this.
What are you talking about, after calling me all the way out here?
Seriously, you're overthinking this. What are you worrying about?
You said your goal was to observe me.
Then we can look for the mother cat and you can observe me at the same time.
But if we do that, the <bouten>variable</bouten>...
To find an answer, you have to consider the <bouten>variables</bouten> too.
I don't know anything about boundaries or whatever...
But if the value changes in the first place, it means a <bouten>variable</bouten> is involved.
And you're ruder than I thought. What did you think of me anyway?
I'm going to sue whoever started that rumor.
Let's find the kitten's mother together. I'll use that... to judge you.
I actually searched the park before you arrived... but there doesn't seem to be a mother cat.
That's not how you do it. How would you know where she is just by walking around?
Then how do we find her?
Exactly. Animals are sensitive to sound.
Kitten, do you want to look for your mother?
...It's too quiet. I don't think its mother will hear it.
Then we need to turn up the volume.
Obviously... we have to make the sound for it.
Should I do it instead? I can do a loud, roaring one if you want.
Looking down under the bench, I saw the mother cat clearly licking the kitten.
Probably when she heard the kitten?
Now I see. You are a <bouten>variable</bouten>. A very dangerous <bouten>variable</bouten>.
Well, but we found the mother cat thanks to that <bouten>variable</bouten>, didn't we?

chat.t: Dream

o: Lewd Dream vs. Winning the Lottery

chat.t: I became a butterfly
If I became a butterfly in my dream
Am I dreaming of being a butterfly
Or is a butterfly dreaming of being me
I don't know that either
That's not what's important
I'm going to look into your subconscious through your dreams
You have no right to refuse

o: Do what you want, but be careful
If you stare too long into the abyss...

chat.t: Meet me at the Ferry Landing

o: The abyss will also tell you to go to the Ferry Landing
When can I get my next lap pillow?

chat.t: So full of ulterior motives
That wasn't a sleeping face though

o: What did my face look like?

chat.t: Grinning from ear to ear
You touched my thigh again too

o: Why are you only telling me this now?

chat.t: Because you were asleep...?
Anyway, see you in your dreams next time

o: Succubus declaration for real this time

chat.t: No, it's not
If a butterfly appears in your dream
That'll be me
What are you planning to do to me?

o: If you're a butterfly, I'll be your flower

chat.t: You don't have to do that
Because I'm already drawn to you

lines.t: The wind is barely blowing today.
Yes. With almost no wind, the water is at its calmest today.
On days like today... the boundary becomes thinnest.
I will cross that boundary and enter your dream.
Why do you look so disappointed?
Anyway, we don't have time. Let's set sail before the weather changes.

Following Kouchou's instructions, I launched the boat from the Ferry Landing
and headed toward the center of the lake.
To enter your dream, you have to be dreaming.
To have a vivid dream, you need to sleep deeply.
If you only half-sleep, your dream will be blurry and awkward.
You're entering my dream, so it'd be a shame if it was a mess.
I don't really get it... but you just need to sleep first.
Ah, I was almost asleep, but you woke me up.
Don't forget that I can monitor your state through my butterflies.
Then you should help me fall asleep.
A lullaby, a lap pillow, a sleep massage...
Is that so? Then it's a contest of who can stay awake longer.
I wouldn't mind spending the whole day here, you know?
Just so you know, I drank three cups of coffee before coming here.
I guess I have no choice. Just this once.
Do you think you can sleep now?
Your thighs are a lot softer than I expected.
I never gave you permission to touch them.
Well, whatever. I'll just pretend it's a wooden pillow.
The pillow is hard, so it's already tough to sleep, and now there's no lullaby... I guess I'm not getting any sleep today.
...Fine, I just have to sing, right?
Kouchou turned her head away in embarrassment for a moment, then slowly began to sing.
It was a voice that sounded familiar from somewhere, carrying a sense of nostalgia.
By the way, I feel incredibly refreshed. It feels like I've had a really great sleep for the first time in ages.
I realized I don't actually need to see your subconscious mind.
I realized I can tell what's on your mind just by looking at your face.
What are you talking about? I'm a master of the poker face.
Does that mean you've been staring at my face this whole time?
My surveillance on you ends here.
Am I finally a free man?
You're not a free man yet.
I rowed back to the lakeshore.
Am I a free man now?
The surveillance is over, but the fact that you are a variable in the boundary remains unchanged.
I am Kouchou. The Priestess of the Red Butterfly. The one who watches the boundary and drives away Aberrant Spirits...
Let me stay by your side.
If you give me lap pillows often from now on, then sure.
...That's playing dirty. I can't refuse if you say it like that.
